name: Soft 3D
note: Smooth toy-like volumes, plain paws, and no fur marks. Keeps the clock and the original personality.

name: Simple shapes
note: A pared-back body built from large rounded shapes. Fewer details compete with the face and clock.

name: Face icon
note: The body and clock step aside so the broad capybara muzzle becomes the main recognition cue.

name: Pocket 3D
note: A little sculpted head that keeps the warmth of the 3D character in a compact shape.
use: App icons · product avatars · brand moments

name: Bold sticker
note: A strong outline gives the head a clear edge. Big shapes carry the personality at small sizes.

name: One-color mark
note: The most reduced direction: one dark silhouette and a few open facial features.
